dashboard.label: Host Summary
dashboard.description: Dashboard to search for files across Zeek and host data using hash, filename, file path, and file size. Includes information about the hosts where the file appeared, last execution time, executing user, and date first seen.

search.query: index=* (sourcetype="bro:files" OR sourcetype="wmi:file") [| makeresults | eval query="*" | eval file_hash=if('$input_file_hash$', " AND hash='$input_file_hash$'", ""), file_name=if('$input_file_name$', " AND filename='$input_file_name$'", ""), file_path=if('$input_file_path$', " AND path='$input_file_path$'", ""), file_size=if('$input_file_size$', " AND size='$input_file_size$'", "") | eval search_query=mvjoin(mvfilter(len(query)!=0), "") | return $search_query] | head 1 | fields - _raw | rename _time as search_time
